candidate_scale_definition: scale_i_t = exp(common_log_scale_i_t + carrier_log_component_i_t); normalized_strength = raw_strength / scale_i_t

summary_metrics.cross_carrier_median_strength_range: max minus min of the five carrier-level medians over the primary months
summary_metrics.within_carrier_monthly_max_to_min: for each carrier, max/min of its three monthly median normalized strengths; report median across five carriers
summary_metrics.breadth: number of carriers whose monthly max/min ratio is lower than raw
summary_metrics.monthly_cell_max_to_min: max/min across the 5 carriers x 3 primary-month median cells

turnover.per_carrier_series: absolute first difference of log(scale_i_t) for consecutive primary-evaluation measurements where both scales are finite
turnover.aggregate_statistics: median of the five per-carrier median values and median of the five per-carrier q95 values
turnover.candidate_multiple_vs_slow: candidate aggregate turnover divided by SLOW_COMMON20_CARRIER120 aggregate turnover
